what: The film fire's look (release 2, behind the land battle's -TheaterLandFilmFire; Brian, 23 November: 'the tank on fire doesnt look realistic'). Laid over battle-fx.json for that battle alone (FBattleEffects::LayOver): each number here replaces the recipe's, the rest stay. The art director's round 1, 15:26Z 23 November: the story and timing passed; the look mended here. 2: the column darker at its root (35 to 45 near the flame tops), grey-brown 80 to 100 with height and age, the shade side darker than the sun side, tall and leaning, readable from 1 to 2 km. 3: a brew-up burns to the battle's end, at its height 6 to 12 minutes, then low (a quarter of the height) with its column all battle. 5: a bright core, fast flicker, soot tongues, a flickering light on the hull and ground. 6: the fuel ball a 0.3 to 0.6 s flash rolling into black smoke with orange inside. 7: cook-offs a flash, sparks and a puff; the big ones jet 4 to 6 m. The vents' own row (fire.vent_tongues) and the smoulder (steam.smoulder) are the recipe's own, as only the film fire burns them.
